entry.name: triangle~
entry.description: triangle~ is a triangle/ramp wavetable with signal input to change phase offset of the peak value. The default lo/hi points are -1. and 1., but may be changed using the lo/hi messages.

arguments.name: peak-value-phase-offset
arguments.description: Peak value phase offset, expressed as a fraction of a cycle, from 0 to 1.0. The default is. A value of 0 produces a ramp waveform when the triangle~ object is driven by a, and a value of 1.0 produces a sawtooth waveform.

messages.name: float
messages.description: In left inlet: Any signal, float, or an input signal progressing from 0 to 1 is used to scan theobject's wavetable. The output of aor some other audio signal can be used to controlas an oscillator, treating the contents of the wavetable as a repeating waveform.In right inlet: Peak value phase offset, expressed as a fraction of a cycle, from 0 to 1.0. The default is 0.5. Scanning through theobject's wavetable using output of awith a phase offset value of 0 produces a ramp waveform, and a phase offset of 1.0 produces a sawtooth waveform.
